claims.excerpt: The Golden Record: Earth’s Contents and Instructions for Playback
claims.claim: The Golden Record contains selected material from Earth and instructions for playing it.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: Both Voyager spacecraft carried a gold-plated record. A committee chaired by Carl Sagan selected its contents for NASA: 115 analog images, natural sounds including surf and whale calls, musical selections spanning cultures and eras, and spoken greetings in 55 languages. Each record was protected by an aluminum jacket and accompanied by a cartridge and needle. Symbolic instructions explain the spacecraft's origin and how to play the record.
claims.narrative: The Golden Record aboard each Voyager spacecraft paired a collection of material from Earth with instructions for playing it.
claims.explanation: The title accurately summarizes the record’s selected Earth material and playback instructions.
claims.materiality: The title’s framing is accurate and central to the piece.
